leads.arxiv: 2502.13270 (arXiv API: v1 2025-02-18; title: REALTALK: A 21-Day Real-World Dataset for Long-Term Conversation)

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A 21-day real messaging-app dialogue corpus: 10 two-person conversations among 10 participants. It has a memory-probing task (728 QAs: 302 multi-hop, 321 temporal, 111 commonsense; judge gpt-4o-mini) and a persona-simulation task.
